note: Owner-held rollback prerequisites. Status is OPEN until the owner records evidence on a GitHub Issue/PR comment (URL only; never paste secrets, backup contents or paths to credentials). Nothing in this repository can confirm these; the rollback preflight fails closed in --mode cutover while any is not CONFIRMED with evidence. This file is never an assertion that a backup exists.

prerequisites.requirement: Clean WordPress rollback copy (files + database) built from pristine sources, scanned clean twice, held outside the static docroot
Day-of backup of the current live WordPress filesystem and database, checksummed, downloaded off-server, separate from the forensic snapshot
Pre-remediation forensic snapshot preserved off-server and write-protected
Restore of the clean copy rehearsed in isolation and the elapsed restore time recorded
Hosting, WordPress, FTP/SSH and database credentials rotated and unknown accounts resolved

Upload/install method confirmed as SSH/SFTP with cPanel File Manager as the fallback (no unverified symlink flip or rsync), PHP kept available for the WordPress fallback, and who installs the docroot .htaccess named
The current WordPress .htaccess saved separately so a rollback can restore it

The entire rollback package (bonafide-release.zip, its checksum, release-manifest.json, SHA256SUMS, RESTORE-ORDER.txt and the rehearsed production.htaccess) archived off-host so the release can be reinstalled without any external service
Named rollback decision-maker and a non-Friday cutover window with all owners available
